name: Verigate Authority
tagline: AI proposes a payment. Verigate checks it before the app requests a wallet signature.
description: Describe a payment in plain language. Anna AI extracts details, asks about ambiguity and flags suspicious context. Verigate's deterministic policy engine decides ALLOW/WARN/BLOCK. For ALLOW, the user confirms the exact payment in the app to issue a one-time signed Execution Authorization. A separate confirmation is required before wallet submission; each step is gated by a 60-second App-scoped, one-time approval that direct model/tool calls cannot create. For native USDC on Base and Ethereum, Verigate ExecutionRouter verifies and consumes the signed permission before the connected EIP-1193 wallet is asked to sign and submit the exact transfer. Wallet private keys stay in the wallet. Anna does not hold keys. Solana remains policy/authorization-only in this release. WARN and BLOCK never receive execution authority. Decision Receipts and permissions are verified with Ed25519.
